GlassLingo / SUPPORT

Support

GlassLingo is a Mac lens that reads and translates the area you need. The first free release supports English to Korean and Korean to English. For support, contact ycw012@naver.com.

Getting started

Requires macOS 26.4 or later. Screen Recording permission is needed to capture the area selected by your lens and read its text.

  1. Launch the app and open the lens from the GlassLingo icon in the menu bar.
  2. Follow the app’s instructions to allow Screen Recording for GlassLingo in macOS System Settings.
  3. Select English and Korean as the source and target. Availability depends on Apple’s language-pair support and the installed models. Preparing models may require an internet connection.
  4. Place the lens over horizontal text, resize it, and release the handle to translate. Use Refresh when moving to another area at the same size.
  5. Check the source and translation together, then copy what you need. The tutorial’s instruction language is separate from the supported translation languages.

Troubleshooting

  • If screen capture still fails after allowing permission, quit GlassLingo fully and reopen it. After reinstalling, check the GlassLingo entry in the Screen Recording list in System Settings.
  • If a language model is not ready, follow the model preparation guidance shown in the app. Installed models and available language pairs can differ between Macs.
  • Small text, blurred images, vertical writing, and complex layouts may produce recognition or translation errors. Check important information against the source.

Optional AI retranslation

On supported systems, you can choose Apple’s on-device model to try a translation using the source and nearby context. Requires macOS 27 or later, an Apple Intelligence-capable Mac, Apple Intelligence enabled, a ready model, and support for the required language and image-processing capabilities. The feature may be unavailable if these conditions are not met. You can return to standard translation.

Translation problem reports and support

Remove personal or confidential information from the source, translation, and description in the report window before copying it or opening an email draft. No screen image is attached. You must review and send the draft yourself in your email app; reports are not sent automatically.

For support, include your macOS version, app version, and what happened. The operator uses your sender email address and report content for support and deletes received emails and separately saved copies within 30 days after resolution. Reusing report content as examples for translation quality checks requires separate consent first. See the Privacy Policy for details.
